bull_case: AI compute 수요가 추론·에이전트·로보틱스로 확장되고 CUDA·NVLink·네트워킹·소프트웨어가 함께 성장하면 5년 3배 규모와 10년 활주로가 가능하다. 게임 GPU에서 데이터센터 플랫폼으로 전환한 조직의 재창조 실적도 강하다.
bear_case: 현재 가격은 이미 Base 가치를 소폭 웃돌고 AI 리더십이 널리 알려져 있다. 고객 집중, custom ASIC, 중국 접근 제한, 대규모 고객지원·보증이 장기 성장의 질과 시장 기대오류를 약화시킨다.
thesis: 5년 기회 규모와 조직 적응력은 최상위권이고 5~10년 성장 지속도 타당하다. 그러나 가격/Base 1.044와 이미 높은 시장 기대, 지원 대상 매출·AR 비중의 미공개 때문에 구체적이고 반증 가능한 시장 과소평가를 입증하지 못한다. LTG 총점은 77.5지만 market_misperception 50으로 Outlier Growth 게이트를 통과하지 못한다.

evidence.claim: Q2 FY27 Data Center revenue was $89,023M, up 117% year over year, while total revenue was $96,221M and gross margin was 75.0%.
CUDA and NVIDIA software developers exceed 7.5 million, supported applications exceed 6,000, and NVIDIA systems account for 78% of TOP500 systems including networking.
NVIDIA moved from graphics into accelerated computing and data-center platforms while maintaining an annual architecture cadence through Blackwell Ultra and Rubin.
At the 2026-09-18 close of $222.27, the locked-policy DCF was Bear $74.99, Base $212.86 and Bull $431.14, so price/Base was 1.0442.
evidence.source: harness deterministic valuation using frozen context and EV inputs

evidence.claim: The Q2 FY27 filing disclosed $36B of additional AI-cloud agreements and maximum gross guarantees of about $108.5B, while supported-customer revenue and receivables were not separately disclosed.

counterevidence: Data Center revenue is already 92.5% of Q2 revenue, increasing single-cycle concentration.
Hyperscalers can fund custom ASICs and reduce NVIDIA pricing power.
The frozen price is above Base value, so a long-duration AI thesis is already materially reflected.
AI-cloud agreements and guarantees make marginal demand quality harder to separate from supported deployment.
unknowns: Supported customers share of revenue and accounts receivable.
Independent Rubin cost per token versus leading custom ASICs.
The firm versus adjustable share of supply and capacity commitments.
Probability-weighted loss and recovery economics for the guarantees.
Standalone software revenue and margin growth.

uncertainties.rationale: Multiple AI value pools support scale, but the share of financed deployment is unknown.
A 5-10 year runway is credible; custom ASICs and market-access loss limit confidence beyond ten years.
Repeated platform transitions are observed, though key-person dependence remains material.
The market already recognizes AI leadership and current price is above Base; a specific underpriced long-term fact is not established.

falsifiers: Data Center revenue declines year over year for two consecutive quarters while gross margin falls below 70%.
Supported-customer revenue or receivables exceed 25% while guarantees and credit support continue to expand.
A refrozen Base value remains below market after owner FCF/share falls short of the locked path for multiple periods.

key_kpis.name: Data Center revenue growth
key_kpis.threshold: positive y/y and above the locked Base path

key_kpis.name: owner FCF per share
key_kpis.threshold: at or above the locked Base path

next_checks: Q3 FY27 10-Q customer support, AR, DSO, guarantees and commitments.
Independent Rubin production TCO versus custom ASICs.
Separately disclosed networking and software revenue and margins.

subscores.rationale: A 3x five-year scale path is credible from accelerated compute, networking and software, supported by Data Center +117% and 75% gross margin. Financing support uncertainty prevents stronger confidence.
A 5-10 year runway is credible from low AI penetration and multiple platform layers; customer concentration, custom ASICs and export controls exclude the 10+ year 90 anchor.
NVIDIA repeatedly reinvented from graphics to accelerated computing and data-center platforms, with a sustained architecture cadence and software ecosystem.
The frozen price is 1.044x Base and the market broadly recognizes AI leadership. A plausible disagreement exists, but reverse-DCF evidence does not show a concrete underpriced long-term fact.

rerun_note: New v3.2 LTG assessment written from the frozen 2026-09-18 evidence set; no post-cutoff facts used.
